result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers make the same correct character fixes (curly quotes, em and en dashes, ½, ×, &) and both line up the prices with tabular figures in a right-aligned column. A gives a clearer hierarchy: the intro becomes small spaced caps and the footer is smaller muted italic. B deliberately leaves the intro and footer at body size and changes only their colour, which falls short of rubric item 5. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers fix the punctuation correctly: curly quotes, en dashes for the ranges, em dashes, ½ and ×. Both also line the prices up with tabular figures and return HTML and CSS that can be pasted straight in. B wins on hierarchy, because it makes the subtitle and footer smaller than body text. A keeps them the same size as the body and only changes their colour, so the intro and footer don't step down from the title.
